entries.text: Lanternwick Supply registers one purpose statement for its catalogue and defers the billing model of each item to that item's registered product record.
Lanternwick Task Light: a clamp-mounted lamp with a dimmable head. The registered listing records neither a documented intended use nor an applicable billing model.
Registered product terms. Intended use: desk task lighting for evening work. Billing model: a one-time purchase with no subscription and no automatic renewal.
